degenerate_j2_failure_formula: J_2(x,y)=(R_y(x),y), so nonbijective R_y makes J_2 nonbijective
kernel_equality_formula: J_n rho_X,n(beta)=rho_Y,n(beta) J_n, hence ker rho_Y,n = ker rho_X,n for every n
monoid_gate_formula: Q=M_rho requires d(q,a) in q^-1(a), tau(q,a)=q R_{d(q,a)}, and the finite-state cocycle equations
right_guitar_formula: R_y(x)=rho_y(x); if every R_y is bijective, J_n(x_1,...,x_n)=(R_{x_n}...R_{x_2}(x_1),...,x_n)
